sources.excerpt: 2007 Korean novel by Han Kang (2024 Nobel laureate) in three parts set in modern-day Seoul. Yeong-hye stops eating meat; her family force-feeds her; she ends up hospitalised. Part 1 is first-person by her husband, part 2 follows her brother-in-law, part 3 her sister. Explores violence and mental instability.
